name: cashflow-monorepo
//: No npm `workspaces` field on purpose: cPanel/CloudLinux npm chokes on a workspace ancestor. apps/web is a standalone app that vendors the engines from packages/core via a tarball (npm run vendor:core). These scripts just cd into each package; they do not use workspace resolution.

scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/core run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/core run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web exec tsc -- --noEmit
